name: jarvis
description: /jarvis speaks a briefing of the last answer: gist, what to do next, which decisions are open. Never speaks on its own.

model.title: Briefing model
model.description: Model alias or id that turns the last answer into the spoken briefing.

voiceDe.title: German voice
voiceDe.description: macOS system voice for German briefings (say -v '?' lists them).

voiceEn.title: English voice
voiceEn.description: macOS system voice for English briefings (say -v '?' lists them).
